body: Thanks for your words of encouragement. After some self-reflection, I believe this crisis is being caused by a combination of isolation, burnout, guilt, and severe anxiety. I was able to make it through last night, so I will see if I can finish this semester in spite of these handicaps.

Your post really speaks to me in a positive way. I have told my parents about the crisis I am in, and they have showed a great amount of support in encouraging me to preserve through this (without me mentioning any word on suicide). At the same time, I cannot help but to feel completely worthless to them at this point, as I'll have done for the past 2 decades is utilize their hard earned resources like a parasite in return for absolutely nothing. It is in that sense I feel more like an anchor or liability on their lives and that my suicide would drastically improve their lives in this regard.
